title: SEPT-ILP student progress file v1
description: The student's portable record of lab state: answers, measurements, confirmations, and timestamps. Browser storage is a convenience cache; this file is the system of record. It is human-readable by design and restores on any browser, any machine, any day.

course.description: Course id the state belongs to.

lab.description: Lab id the state belongs to.

contentVersion.description: The lab contentVersion this state was recorded against. Restore warns when versions differ.

confirmed.description: Checkpoint id → ISO timestamp of confirmation.

ordering.description: Ordering key → item keys in the student's current arrangement, plus solved state.

evidence.description: Evidence key → chosen filename (a memory aid; file contents are never stored).

tabs.description: Tab group key → selected tab key.

student.description: Identity the student types for the submission package (names, student numbers, section, instructor). Stays in the browser and in files the student downloads; never transmitted.
